assumptions.clock: Published nominal5/5/10/3Hz mapped to5Hz; no measured timestamps
assumptions.libero_execution: Separate uncalibrated shared-Cartesian convention; no physical target evaluation in this training entry

model_selection: Final65536-update endpoint only; full source validation at32768 and65536, no early stopping or best-checkpoint search
sampling: Inverse-source-window-count weighted replacement; batch8 except real short pass tails, no padding or dropped samples
initialization: Fresh per seed; preflight contributes frozen asset/tokenizer identity only, never learned weights
augmentation_design: All conditions share data/window order by seed and full update budget. Future paraphrases need five reviewed alternatives. Counterfactual negative exposure requires reviewed scene mismatch and explicit command eligibility; banks not admitted by this release.
retention: Active runs keep latest full resume state. Completed runs export and verify all learned tensors/provenance, then retire only that completed optimizer checkpoint.
